wa-king-2026-seattle-muni-pos5-newsom-ga.name: Garmon Newsom
wa-king-2026-seattle-muni-pos5-newsom-ga.bio: Former Burien City Attorney, Assistant District Attorney and Pro Tem Judge with more than 30 years as a criminal and civil attorney.

positions.stance: Judicial philosophy centers on "impartial application of the law as written, grounded in precedent yet mindful of real-world impacts on the parties before the court."
Believes in judicial restraint, "interpreting ordinances and statutes as written" rather than substituting personal policy preferences or yielding to political pressure.
Says "restraint is not indifference" and every decision must rest on sound legal reasoning, shared clearly, "with compassion for all who are affected."
"The judge’s role is to apply the law fairly, not to make policy (which is for other elected public servants)."
